create_jina_embeddings_v3_model: create a JinaEmbeddingsV3Model instance from JinaEmbeddingsV3Config for dense text embeddings
build_jina_embeddings_v3_config: build a JinaEmbeddingsV3Config with custom hidden_size num_hidden_layers and num_attention_heads
test_jina_embeddings_v3_forward: test the JinaEmbeddingsV3Model forward pass with input_ids and attention_mask
run_jina_embeddings_v3_mlm: run JinaEmbeddingsV3ForMaskedLM to predict masked tokens in a sequence
summarize_jina_embeddings_v3_attention: summarize the JinaEmbeddingsV3Attention forward method with rotary embeddings and bidirectional masking
